name: throw
about: Measures what one mod's runtime script exception does to the other mods and to the game (gamelab-throw): a caught null access (getExceptionInfo is not registered), then a [Hook] GameModeUpdate that throws every frame beside one that does not, then a module whose UpdateFrame throws every frame. A screen shake entry, aged by the game mode's update after its module loop, is read 120 frames after it is added in each phase.

steps.name: hook A throwing: the shake read
